AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.

----
